newsitem.title: GREECE: CONSERVATIVE MANOS SLAMS STATE ERT TV OVER RECORD EXPENSES.
newsitem.headline: CONSERVATIVE MANOS SLAMS STATE ERT TV OVER RECORD EXPENSES.

text.p: Former conservative National Economy Minister Stephanos Manos slammed state ERT TV for wasting taxpayers' money in a response to a statement by the union of ERT employees who accused him of favouring privatisations for personal benefit.

Private TV stations spend 20 billion drachmas a year compared to 80 billion drachmas by state ERT TV although ERT is viewed by only a tenth of those watching MEGA or Antena private TV stations, said Manos who called for a 50 percent cut in ERT's budget. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
